import sys

def mod_pow(base, exp, p):
    result = 1
    base %= p
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            result = (result * base) % p
        base = (base * base) % p
        exp >>= 1
    return result

def precompute(fact, invFact, maxVal, p):
    fact[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, maxVal + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % p
    invFact[maxVal] = mod_pow(fact[maxVal], p - 2, p)
    for i in range(maxVal - 1, -1, -1):
        invFact[i] = invFact[i+1] * (i+1) % p

def next_power_of_two(x):
    power = 1
    while power < x:
        power <<= 1
    return power

def fw_transform(arr, len_arr, inverse=False, p=p):
    buffer = [0] * len_arr
    for i in range(len_arr):
        buffer[i] = arr[i]
    
    if inverse:
        for step in range(1, len_arr, step << 1):
            for i in range(0, len_arr, step << 1):
                for j in range(step):
                    buffer[i + j + step] = (buffer[i + j + step] - buffer[i + j] % p + p) % p
    else:
        for step in range(1, len_arr, step << 1):
            for i in range(0, len_arr, step << 1):
                for j in range(step):
                    buffer[i + j + step] = (buffer[i + j + step] + buffer[i + j]) % p
    
    for i in range(len_arr):
        arr[i] = int(buffer[i] % p)
        if arr[i] < 0:
            arr[i] += p

def adjust(x, mod2):
    if x >= mod2:
        x -= mod2
    return x

def multiply(f, tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, t, popCount, maxVal, p, mod2):
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(maxVal + 1):
            tmp1[i][j] = 0
        for j in range(maxVal + 1):
            t[i][j] = 0
    
    for i in range(maxVal + 1):
        tmp1[popCount[i]][i] = f[i]
    
    for i in range(20):
        fw_transform(tmp1[i], maxVal + 1, False, p)
    
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q + 1):
            for s in range(maxVal + 1):
                t[q + l][s] = adjust(t[q + l][s] + tmp1[q][s] * tmp2[l][s], mod2)
    
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxVal + 1):
            tmp3[q][s] = int(t[q][s] % p)
    
    for i in range(20):
        fw_transform(tmp3[i], maxVal + 1, True, p)
    
    for i in range(maxVal + 1):
        f[i] = tmp3[popCount[i]][i]

def square_transform(tmp2, t, popCount, maxVal, p, mod2):
    buffer = [[0] * (maxVal + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(maxVal + 1):
            t[i][j] = 0
    
    for q in range(20):
        for l in range(20 - q + 1):
            for s in range(maxVal + 1):
                t[q + l][s] = adjust(t[q + l][s] + tmp2[q][s] * tmp2[l][s], mod2)
    
    for q in range(20):
        for s in range(maxVal + 1):
            buffer[q][s] = int(t[q][s] % p)
    
    for i in range(20):
        fw_transform(buffer[i], maxVal + 1, True, p)
    
    for i in range(20):
        for j in range(maxVal + 1):
            tmp2[i][j] = 0
    
    for i in range(maxVal + 1):
        tmp2[popCount[i]][i] = buffer[popCount[i]][i]
    
    for i in range(20):
        fw_transform(tmp2[i], maxVal + 1, False, p)

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not input_data:
        return
    n = int(input_data[0])
    k = int(input_data[1])
    p = int(input_data[2])
    
    mod2 = p * p
    
    if n & 1:
        print(mod_pow(k, n, p))
        return
    
    f = [0] * ((1 << 19) + 5)
    f[0] = 1
    
    maxVal = next_power_of_two(n + 1) - 1
    
    fact = [0] * (maxVal + 1)
    invFact = [0] * (maxVal + 1)
    precompute(fact, invFact, maxVal, p)
    
    popCount = [0] * (maxVal + 1)
    for i in range(maxVal + 1):
        popCount[i] = bin(i).count('1')
    
    tmp2 = [[0] * (maxVal + 1) for _ in range(20)]
    for i in range(maxVal + 1):
        tmp2[popCount[i]][i] = invFact[i]
    
    for i in range(20):
        fw_transform(tmp2[i], maxVal + 1, False, p)
    
    originalK = k
    while k:
        if k & 1:
            tmp1 = [[0] * (maxVal + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            tmp3 = [[0] * (maxVal + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            t = [[0] * (maxVal + 1) for _ in range(20)]
            multiply(f, tmp1, tmp2, tmp3, t, popCount, maxVal, p, mod2)
        k >>= 1
        if k:
            square_transform(tmp2, t, popCount, maxVal, p, mod2)
    
    result = (mod_pow(originalK, n, p) - fact[n] * f[n] % p + p) % p
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
